name: Loving Your Child
overview: Scripture teaches that loving your child involves both discipline and nurturing grounded in the Lord's instruction. Proverbs emphasizes that sparing correction is a sign of neglect, while timely chastening reflects true love. Parents are called to train their children in the right way so that they remain faithful throughout life, and fathers are specifically instructed to avoid provoking their children to anger, instead raising them with godly nurture and admonition.
